title: Apricot Chicken Salad with Tarragon, Grapes and Almonds
changes_from_base: Chopped dried apricots and grapes bring sweetness, toasted almonds replace the celery crunch, and basil joins the tarragon.
summary: A sweet-savoury chicken salad with chopped dried apricots, red grapes, toasted almonds, tarragon and basil in a light mustard mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Poach the chicken
steps.text: Put the chicken and bay leaf in a saucepan, cover with cold water by 2 cm and bring to a bare simmer. Cover, turn off the heat and leave 15-17 min until the thickest part reads 74 °C. Lift out, cool 15 min, then shred or dice.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: Stir the mayonnaise, apricots, lemon, mustard, shallot, cayenne and salt together and leave 5 min so the apricots soften.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Fold in the chicken, grapes, almonds and herbs. Chill 20 min and serve on soft lettuce leaves.

tips: Soften the apricots in the dressing for 5 minutes first.
Toast the almonds just before adding so they stay crisp.
Try it in croissants or soft lettuce leaves.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
